author: CT-Green
body: Mangi Con Amore - Little Italian restaurant in Laguna Hills, right off I5. Great sandwiches and pasta. The location is weirdly in an office park, but once you're inside its very homey and the kind of place where the other diners are casually speaking across the tables with one another, like one community. Its one of our favorites to bring out of town guests.
